findings: SUGGESTION (untested inference, publication_candidate.receive): sparse-checkout patterns are the audited path names in --no-cone glob mode, but scan() permits fnmatch metacharacters (*, ?, [) in names; a * path can over-match and materialize unaudited baseline/legacy files into the protected cache worktree, and a [ path can silently fail to materialize its own file while still returning STAGED_NOT_PUBLISHED. No publication or exfiltration path results (worktree stays inside the protected cache; publish pushes commits, not the worktree). Smallest fix: reject or escape glob metacharacters when forming sparse patterns.

SUGGESTION (verified in source): several fail-closed refusals surface as unnamed errors rather than named codes — missing baseline commit in cache (cat-file -e via check_output), malformed bundle at list-heads, cross-filesystem os.link EXDEV in prepare, BadZipFile in actions verify — all become CalledProcessError/BROKER_FAILURE_PRESERVED. Behavior remains fail-closed; operator diagnosis is harder. Smallest fix: wrap in named ValueError codes.

SUGGESTION (verified in source): Broker.operator('initialize') sets ledger.allow_initialization=True permanently for the broker lifetime, disarming the OPERATOR_MUST_INITIALIZE_STATE_REF guard for any future cas(None, ...) path; currently only operator-authenticated initialize reaches it and existing-state overwrite still fails via the absent-ref lease (LIMITER_STATE_ALREADY_EXISTS). Smallest fix: clear the flag in try/finally.

SUGGESTION (verified in source): operations_backup.backup copies only directories under outputs (if p.is_dir()), silently omitting any top-level regular files from the backup while reporting success; backup_handover's turns copytree has no such gap. Smallest fix: copy or explicitly refuse top-level files in outputs.

EVIDENCE DISTINCTION (verified from supplied receipts): all hosted receipts bind to installed source 6863968863ddfb1d82b25c7b358857e666c950a5 (backup receipt additionally to backup code 72c023f4), not to cba7043. They demonstrate restart recovery (broker pid 228837→230927, rc 0), duplicate-safe recovery (recover phase ledger_count 1→1, zero model calls, no replay), non-root bounded execution (uid 997, no_new_privileges=1, cgroup caps), restored original evidence bytes, and honest limitations including the prior launch failing before the model on a nonexistent input file. Nothing hosted covers cba7043: candidate intake, Actions transport, and current backup code rest on the supplied synthetic tests, which were not executed in this source-only review. Hosted verification of cba7043 is a required next step, not an inferred pass.

VERIFIED POSITIVES (source): receiver independently re-audits every candidate with exact pins, bundle head pinned to 'source HEAD', size/sha256 re-check, baseline-presence requirement, alternates/symlink/hardlink cache-independence checks, audit-before-checkout, and post-checkout clean-status gate, all through a hooks/credentials-disabled sanitized git wrapper; stage_candidate requires no credential and cannot publish; publish/create remain pinned to the single authorized branch/remote with exact-authority echo and force-with-lease CAS; Actions retrieval binds run/attempt/source/workflow-sha256/artifact-name with size caps and never forwards Authorization to signed storage (redirect captured, host allowlisted); limiter treats porcelain '=' as race/duplicate with re-read, replays duplicates from durable state, latches halt across midnight, refuses clock rollback, and restricts reset/initialize to operators; backups verify byte identity and DB integrity and honestly report authority_restored=false, models_started=0, provider_recovery_proven=false. Reserved gates and scientific approvals are preserved unchanged.
